race.title: Catertech North East Ltd Mares' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Having finished second in a race that worked out well at Newcastle in the spring, MIDNIGHT BELLA didn't get the chance to show what she could do following a breathing operation/8 months off when unseating mid-race in a course novice 10 days ago. A low-mileage mare, she's well worth another chance back in a handicap over this slightly longer trip. Stellarmasterpiece has enjoyed a highly productive 2026 under both codes and is fancied to play a lead role once more. MIDNIGHT BELLA STELLARMASTERPIECE (FR) LEAVE HER TO ME
race.bettingForecast: Stellarmasterpiece (13/8), Midnight Bella (15/8), Strathcatcha (4/1), Eremenko (12/1), Leave Her To Me (12/1), Khaleesi Queen (25/1)
